startup_investigation.observation: Cold Podman keep-id storage-chown-by-maps preparation ran from +2.00s through +29.06s; initialize arrived intact at +29.39s. Short startup deadlines caused the observed failures.
startup_investigation.resolution: Build and container install now prepare the exact rootless UID/GID mapping before the harness starts. A rebuilt image and installed wrapper passed the full Sway spectator suite.
startup_investigation.unshipped_experiment: Removed a speculative stdio readiness proxy; no evidence of lost requests, no action retries introduced.
